title: Thin the alethiometer case within clearance and relief rules, with consistent documents
derivation: Public hardware-branch commit 4528e96 (5 mm hand standoffs, 1.5 mm crystal clearance, P2 hinge relief widened to clear screw tips, README/BOM/ASSEMBLY updates). The CAD module needs cadquery/shapely, so its Z stack-up and hinge-relief constants are excerpted verbatim into a stdlib model; document excerpts are lightly normalized to be consistent with that model (upper-shell flange stated as the model's shell height).
coverage: Constraint validator over a multi-file design change: optimal catalog choice, design-rule relief derivation (perturbation-tested), preserved fixed parts, and document/model consistency.
residual_rubric: Physical manufacturability beyond the stated rules (renders, DXF/STEP regeneration) is out of scope and not graded.
